primary_outcome: the report printed by /app/tools/noisedose_run.py gives every worker's and every similar-exposure group's dose, TWA and status, and every worker's ceiling and impulse flags, as manual HC-4 gives them

obligations.contribution: reference duration at the level a counted reading is counted at: 85 dBA criterion, 3 dB exchange; a reading above the ceiling level is counted where today's step counts it (silent)

authority.anchor: The reference duration at a level L is

separability.rationale: the reference duration sets every measured dose, hence shift dose, TWA, status and group dose

obligations.discriminating_instance: full-shift readings at 80.0, 85.0, 91.0 and 140.0 dBA, and a one-minute run at 140.0 dBA on a 1,440-minute shift; readings at 115.0, 115.1, 118.5, 131.2 and 140.0 dBA beside ordinary readings
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: keep the federal 90 dBA / 5 dB (shipped); count a reading above the ceiling at its own level (natural over-repair)

obligations.contribution: a reading exactly at the 80.0 dBA threshold level adds dose

authority.anchor: A counted reading is a reading at or above

separability.rationale: decides which readings enter the measured dose

obligations.discriminating_instance: runs at 79.9, 80.0 and 80.1 dBA beside a louder run

obligations.contribution: sampled time is the length of every reading, below-threshold readings included; a run logged at 0.0 is not a reading

authority.anchor: A worker's sampled time is the total length of the worker's readings

separability.rationale: sampled time is the projection denominator of the shift dose

obligations.discriminating_instance: partial surveys mixing counted readings with readings at 40.0-79.9 dBA; separately, partial surveys holding runs logged at 0.0 among counted readings
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: count only readings that add dose (shipped), or count every run's minutes including runs logged at 0.0 (natural over-repair)

obligations.contribution: a partial survey (2.5: sampled time at least three quarters of the shift and shorter than it) is projected to the worker's own shift; one of the whole shift or longer keeps its measured dose; any other survey keeps today's step (silent)

authority.anchor: A partial survey is projected to the worker's shift

separability.rationale: the shift dose feeds the TWA, the status and the group mean

obligations.discriminating_instance: full-shift surveys one minute short of, equal to and longer than shifts of 360-1,440 minutes; a survey at exactly three quarters of a 600-minute shift; surveys below three quarters on shifts of 60, 360, 720 and 1,440 minutes; an empty log
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: project to 480 minutes (shipped); apply the own-shift projection to every survey, or leave a survey below three quarters unprojected (natural over-repairs)

obligations.contribution: TWA = 85 + 3 log2(D/100) for a dose above nought, reported to the nearest tenth of a decibel

separability.rationale: the reported TWA decides the worker and group status

obligations.discriminating_instance: doses whose TWA has hundredths of 0.04 and 0.06 on either side of a tenth; a quiet worker's dose of nought with no TWA

obligations.contribution: ceiling flag for a reading above 115.0 dBA; impulse flag for a peak of 140.0 dBC or more

authority.anchor: An impulse is a peak of 140.0 dBC or more

separability.rationale: a flag makes the worker's status over whatever the TWA

obligations.discriminating_instance: peaks at 139.9, 140.0 and 170.0 dBC; readings at 115.0 and 115.1 dBA on workers whose TWA is below the action level
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: treat only a peak above 140.0 dBC as an impulse

obligations.contribution: over when flagged or when the TWA is above 85.0 dB; action from 82.0 up to 85.0 dB; below otherwise

authority.anchor: "action" when the TWA is from 82.0 dB up to 85.0 dB

separability.rationale: worker status is the report's compliance verdict and uses the same bands as the group status

obligations.discriminating_instance: reported TWAs of 81.9, 82.0, 85.0 and 85.1 dB, including unrounded 81.95-81.99 and 85.04
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: federal bands 85 and 90, or over from 85.0 inclusive

obligations.contribution: a group's dose is the mean of every member's shift dose, a quiet member's nought included; its TWA follows from that dose and its status from the TWA alone

authority.anchor: A group's dose is the mean of its members' shift doses

separability.rationale: group dose is built from the members' shift doses and yields the group TWA and status

obligations.discriminating_instance: a group mixing a 95 dBA and two 83-84 dBA members; a group with a quiet full-shift member whose dose is nought
obligations.wrong_but_plausible: average the members' TWAs in decibels (shipped), or keep the has-a-TWA filter that drops quiet members

obligations.contribution: decode runs and peaks from the survey file
